mathematical_judgment.quantifiers: For every such game and explicit common certificate; no certificate search asserted. Every integer R≥L≥1 has a sharp subset-shift family at β=L/R, val=β/L=1/R. No arbitrary independently specified real β sharpness claim.
assumptions: E nonempty; nonempty finite alphabets; total projection maps; nonnegative rational edge weights summing to one
same μ_z at each vertex for all incident edges
projection support and both pointwise marginal inequalities for ξ_e
nonempty right supports; integer L≥1; zero-weight edges and τ_e=β=0 permitted
mathematical_judgment.complete_proof_location: The primary H1 body contains α_e≥τ_e, support-uniform expectation, independent left argmax then right best response, explicit rational bit-complexity, weak q1 proof, all-integer shift sharpness, and source soundness boundary.
not_assumed: one global joint law for all ξ_e
a scheduling tree, fixed k/h, or complete YES schedules
mathematical_judgment.q1_q2_boundary: q2 denotes the historical strengthened version, not a fixed alphabet parameter. q1 β²/L remains valid. q2 strengthens the certified lower bound; it need not increase an input's actual initial expectation.
mathematical_judgment.soundness_boundary: With all right alphabet sizes R and a nonempty NO side, γ≥1/R; decoder contradiction needs strict β/L>γ. Exact L=θR, β=θ gives only1/R.
mathematical_judgment.separate_open_quantifiers: For every fixed δ∈(0,1), jointly construct Fδ, complete actual YES OPT≤T, extraction from every actual σ with Cmax≤(2−δ)T, and applicable source hardness. Decoder does not prove these contracts.
mathematical_judgment.separate_fixed_tree_contracts: The open body's fixed-height leaf-flow and same-P p-complete-YES mixing comparisons have their own k,h,p,N≥p hypotheses. They are not decoder hypotheses or the same proposition.
